mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO sgtransit_complaint_sms_notification ( complaint_no, notification_type, recipient_phone, message_text, send_status, attempt_count ) VALUES ( #{complaintNo}, #{notificationType}, #{recipientPhone}, #{messageText}, 'PENDING', 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT notification_no FROM sgtransit_complaint_sms_notification WHERE send_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND attempt_count < 3 ORDER BY created_at, notification_no LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE sgtransit_complaint_sms_notification SET send_status='SENDING', attempt_count=attempt_count+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notification_no=#{notificationNo} AND send_status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND attempt_count < 3
UPDATE sgtransit_complaint_sms_notification SET send_status='SENT', last_error=NULL, sent_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notification_no=#{notificationNo}
UPDATE sgtransit_complaint_sms_notification SET send_status='FAILED', last_error=#{lastError}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE notification_no=#{notificationNo}
UPDATE sgtransit_complaint_sms_notification SET send_status='FAILED', last_error='발송 처리 중 애플리케이션이 중단되어 재시도합니다.', updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE send_status='SENDING' AND updated_at < #{cutoff}
